text: 据海关统计，今年前三季度，我国货物贸易进出口39.94万亿元，同比增长18.8%。其中，出口23.2万亿元，增长16.4%，进口16.74万亿元，增长22.3%。月度增速连续6个月保持两位数增长，9月份进出口5.16万亿元，首次突破了5万亿元，增长27.5%。其中，出口3.03万亿元，增长29.6%；进口2.13万亿元，增长24.6%。
text_en: According to customs statistics, in the first three quarters of this year, China's goods trade imports and exports totaled 39.94 trillion yuan, up 18.8% year-on-year. Among this, exports were 23.2 trillion yuan, up 16.4%, and imports were 16.74 trillion yuan, up 22.3%. Monthly growth remained in double digits for six consecutive months. In September, imports and exports totaled 5.16 trillion yuan, exceeding 5 trillion yuan for the first time, up 27.5%. Among this, exports were 3.03 trillion yuan, up 29.6%; imports were 2.13 trillion yuan, up 24.6%.
